column3: if - The Abominable Kirino Chapter
Haa haa haa... That was scary...
You reap what you sow. Doing that kind of a seductive pose at that kind of a place...
Is that wrong? Or strange? Huh?
Of course it's strange. Everyone was waving cameras around and you just had to provide the source material.
In the first place, aren't you used to being photographed? Why did you get scared?
Because! You or work is different. The atmosphere felt unsettling! I couldn't help it.
Well, so that is also how cute you could be.
Shut up!
What are you getting mad for...
I-I'm not mad!
Well even if you say that... or rather, nothing I say would make a difference.
What's that?  You don't care what happens to me?!
That's not what I mean!
Hmph!  Well, fine.
What's with that!
You think it's okay for me to be photographed like crazy and plastered all over the internet?!
Okay, okay, I got it.
Are you going to brush it off with that again?!
That's not it. You were scared, right?
Huh?
Aren't you just getting mad at me even though you were in the wrong?
N-No way!  What do you mean?!
Despite that, how come your face is all red?  Well, that's kinda...
I don't understand...
Huh? What do you mean by that?
Was I wrong? Huh? Huh?!
In any case, I just wanted to say one thing.
I couldn't completely protect you. I'm sorry.
Oh...
But, after you did what you came for, you have to get out quick. Otherwise. it will turn into a bother.
Okay. But, I just want to take a few more...
...Fine. Five minutes. Exactly five minutes and we're out, alright?
Okay. I will try if I can.
Fine, fine. *sigh*...
Huh?  What's with this, "I've already given up" expression?
T-That's not it!
If that's the case then that's fine... but...
You still haven't learned your lesson yet?!
I'll be finished in 5 minutes!
You don't know what's going to happen in those five minutes! Just maybe your picture will be spread all over the world!
It's like that, that thing... You'll be "En Vogue." "Vogue!"
Huh?! "Vogue?"  Who do you think you are?
Is that the best comeback you can do?!
But...
At these crucial times, you have to protect me properly, okay?
Ah, well, I guess that's true...
Well then, that's good...
You can't depend on someone else, right?
B-But there's no one else...
A-Anyways! Just a bit more. That's okay, right?
Alright, fine! Let's hurry up and finish this, okay?
Of course! Just wait here!
Ahh... So you were just waiting for a convenient time...
What do you mean? It sounds like I'm the one who's wrong here!
